Problem 6

answers.label: a
b
c
answers.code:
spend40 <- function(pack_type, reps = 10000) {
  n <- if (pack_type == 1) 8 else 20
  draws <- matrix(open_packs(pack_type, n * reps), nrow = n)
  complete <- apply(draws, 2, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 5)
  100 * mean(complete)
}
set.seed(506)
spend40(1)
spend40(2)
answers.text: Pack 2 performs better: estimates are roughly 32% versus 40%. Every column is one budget-sized experiment. The official code returns a fraction via mean(complete); multiplying by 100 makes the returned value a percentage as requested.
